svg.title: telescopic sliding preview
svg.desc: 4000 mm opening · 1000 mm high · traditional victorian · Black satin. Figma CAD silhouette — no baked millimetres on the drawing. Telescopic LOCKED = 3 overlapping panels (CA-11). N parallel tracks; front = motor-side leaf. Depth stagger + plan cue show stacked planes; stack zone outside parking post.
